_comment: Chapter 5 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): Mira in the village (hub_mira). S6 (docs/gameplay/23 §8): "How are things?" changes with the story (news_*: the latest chapter done).

text.zh_TW: 米菈在教村裡的小孩揮木劍。「看好了！我哥是皇家騎士，我也會成為騎士！」小托：「那我要當水桶騎士！」
text.en: Mira is teaching the village kids to swing wooden swords. "Watch closely! My brother's a royal knight, and I'll be a knight too!" Tobi: "Then I'll be a bucket knight!"

text.zh_TW: 米菈：「我哥每天都寫信回來，每一封都問我有沒有吃飯。你們男生都一樣！」
text.en: Mira: "My brother writes home every day, and every letter asks whether I'm eating. You boys are all the same!"

text.zh_TW: 米菈：「那些孩子叫我『米菈老師』！……哥回來的時候，你要幫我跟他炫耀。」
text.en: Mira: "The children call me 'Teacher Mira'! ...When my brother comes back, you have to help me show off to him."
